name: Costco Food Court $1.50 Quarter-Pound All-Beef Hot Dog (Plain) & Cheese Pizza Slice
brandOrRestaurant: Costco Food Court (North Logan, Draper, South Jordan & Nationwide)
whyItWorks: The iconic $1.50 Kirkland all-beef hot dog on a soft steamed white bun is zero-fiber and dairy-free when eaten plain without raw chopped onions or relish.
prepOrOrderInstructions: For the gentlest option, eat the All-Beef Hot Dog on the white bun with a light line of yellow mustard or ketchup only (no chopped raw onions); if ordering the Cheese Pizza slice, blot top oil and take a Lactaid.
watchOuts: High cheese/grease load on the Costco Cheese Pizza slice
Skip raw chopped onions and spicy deli mustard at the condiment pump
